skill.name: kokkai
skill.description: 国会会議録検索システムの公式APIで国会議事録(第1回国会1947年〜最新)を検索する。発言本文のキーワード・発言者・会議名・院・開催日・回国数での検索に対応し、発言単位/会議単位/会議一覧の3モードで返す。APIキー・ログイン不要。法律の条文そのものはegov-laws、書誌はndl-booksを使う。投票結果・議員個人の属性情報は対象外。
skill.summary: Search Japanese National Diet speeches and meetings through the official National Diet Library API.
skill.author: tahodev

content.value_statement: Finding relevant speeches across decades of Japanese parliamentary records requires precise filters. This skill queries the official API and returns speeches, meeting records, or meeting metadata.
actual_capabilities: Search speech text with keywords, combining space-separated terms using AND.
Filter by speaker, meeting name, house, date range, and Diet session number.
Retrieve individual speeches, meetings with their speeches, or lightweight meeting lists.
Return speech identifiers, speaker metadata, dates, and source citation URLs when available.
Expose total matches, returned counts, and the next record position for manual pagination.
Request JSON through a Python standard library helper without API credentials or external packages.
limitations: Requires Python 3 and network access to the official API.
New proceedings may appear about one month after the meeting; immediate coverage is not guaranteed.
Each request returns at most 100 speeches or meeting-list entries, or 10 full meetings; pagination is manual.
Does not retrieve legal provisions, voting results, or standalone legislator profiles.

use_cases.title: Trace policy discussions
use_cases.description: Find speeches on a policy topic within a date range and retain official links for further review.

use_cases.title: Check parliamentary quotations
use_cases.description: Search a speaker and keyword, then inspect dated proceedings before quoting a statement.

use_cases.title: Collect historical meeting references
use_cases.description: List meetings for a named committee or Diet session and retrieve selected meeting records.

prompt_templates.title: Find topic speeches
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three National Diet speeches mentioning [Japanese keyword]. Show the speaker, date, meeting name, and official source link.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a speaker search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find speeches by [full Japanese speaker name] about [Japanese keyword] in [house] between [start date] and [end date]. Include source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine speaker, topic, house, and dates

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a complete meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: List meetings matching [Japanese committee name] in Diet session [number]. Retrieve one selected meeting with its speeches and summarize it with citations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: move from meeting metadata to full proceedings

prompt_templates.title: Review paginated evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Search speeches containing both [Japanese term A] and [Japanese term B] during [date range]. Review three pages and separate retrieved evidence from interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: bounded pagination and evidence review

best_practices: Use full Japanese speaker names and bounded date ranges to reduce ambiguous matches.
Use speech keywords for AND searches and the meeting-name filter for meeting titles.
Keep official citation links and record dates; confirm publication lag before describing results as current.
anti_patterns: Assuming an empty search proves that a topic was never discussed.
Treating one returned page as the complete result set.
Sending confidential information as search terms to the public API.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The skill uses the public National Diet Library API without a login or API key.

faq.question: What do I need to run the helper?
faq.answer: Python 3 and internet access are required. The helper uses only Python standard library modules.

faq.question: Which records can I search?
faq.answer: The skill targets National Diet proceedings from 1947 onward. Choose individual speeches, complete meeting records, or meeting metadata.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists all three tools. Running the helper requires a host environment with Python execution and network access.

faq.question: Are searches private?
faq.answer: Search terms are sent to the official API and included in the returned query URL. Do not submit confidential information.

faq.question: Why are recent speeches missing or results incomplete?
faq.answer: Publication can lag by about one month. Requests also have record limits; use the returned next position to retrieve further pages.
